answer: Audits are recorded in pulse, queued in knoll, and river publishes the wait time. A farm of 197 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 88 identities per epoch. A farm of 3684 identities would post 3192 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
